newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open steady to 0.10 ct lower.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open steady to 0.10 ct lower.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open steady to 0.10 cent a lb lower on Friday, based on market orders at 1019 EDT, traders said.

"The market is dead," a floor source said. But the market has a negative tone. "We are not exporting a heck of a lot of cotton, the weekly export sales reports have been weak and the planting intentions went up a little bit in the last (USDA) report," he said.
Also the planting conditions for this year's crop have been favorable with a lot of subsoil moisture in key growing areas, sources said.
